page.layout: One block of text, centred, full width at the top of the page; below it a date line. No margins with text. The digitiser's URL at the foot is not printed text and is left out.

main_text.p: diose legas, & pie amplectaris, & omnia Ecclesiæ tempora sapienter conferas, sæpe in hac ipsa collatione doctrinam de Anni metis Ecclesiæ necessariam esse cogitabis. Quare te etiam propter communem Ecclesiæ utilitatem oro, ut inter cæteras partes iuste & salutaris gubernationis hanc curam quoq; tuendi & propagandi artes has ad posteritatem complectaris. Bene uale, Cal. Iunij. Anno 1551.

page.notes: The text is in a single roman type, a mix of long and round s is not used; the long s is rendered as s. Words such as "metis" and "Anni metis" are as printed. The date line reads "Cal. Iunij. Anno / 1551" with the year set in spaced large numerals ("I 5 5 I"), transcribed here as 1551. The page is a continuation from a previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The first word "diose" is a fragment from a line cut at the top and is kept as printed.
